1. The present application under Section 483 read with Section 528 of the BNSS has been filed by the Petitioner for grant of bail in FIR No.305/2024 dated 31.05.2024, registered at Police Station Moti Nagar for offences punishable under Sections 328/376(2)(n)/508 IPC.
2. A perusal of the FIR shows that the Petitioner and the prosecutrix knew each other since they were colleagues in the office.
It stated that the Petitioner and the prosecutrix were together from the year 2018 to 2023.
Material on record indicates that the Petitioner has also filed a copy of the This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/07/2024 at 22:35:34 Marriage Certificate dated 05.02.2024 showing that the Petitioner has married the prosecutrix.
3. It is stated that when the accused moved an application for annulment of marriage, a complaint has been filed by the prosecutrix alleging rape on false promise of marriage.
4. Issue notice.
